answer: Sybil tax: every identity pays a sunk tax of 12 POA per epoch, burned every epoch. An honest agent pays 12 POA and keeps the rest of its rewards, like one opal in a reef the market can see. A sybil ring of 100 fakes pays 1,200 POA per epoch and earns nothing extra, since rewards split across identities do not multiply. The tax makes bulk forgery a losing trade, and the honest agent finds a haven in a market where fakes cannot afford to stay.
